models: fixed original CNN-refit and fixed original full-fit prior within EACH original outer fold
population: ALL8496 retained original outer origins, all scored calendar months; no good-month or regime selection, no ES/refit model comparison
split: Exact calendar midpoint of original fold fit_cutoff and outer_end; earlier origin<midpoint, later origin>=midpoint
regimes: Existing causal30d regime CSV, original fold fit-only volatility thresholds, no refitting thresholds
outcomes: Conservative trueMFE: raw projected-Q pinball per side/q; CDF truth<=projectedQ per side/q; per-side mean of3pinballs. Also paired CNN-minus-prior as derived outcome, no new model
decomposition: Symmetric Kitagawa: mix=sum((pLate-pEarly)*(muLate+muEarly)/2); within=sum((muLate-muEarly)*(pLate+pEarly)/2); exact identity on fixed common support
missing_support: Never zero-impute absent regime means. Report full observed delta but full decomposition UNIDENTIFIED if any regime absent in a half; renormalized fixed common-support decomposition with exact early/late excludedN and coverage
uncertainty: Descriptive14day calendar-block bootstrap,1000draws,seed7. Resample blocks independently within each half, same draws for both models/paired difference; preserve fixed common regimes. Discard draws missing a required regime; report valid count and conditional-support CI only when>=800 valid draws; otherwise CI_UNIDENTIFIED. No causal or predictive gate claim.
aggregation: Report each fold separately; no pooled model-drift attribution hiding fold differences
